[Call for Papers] JEACS 8.2 (2027) Special Issue: Affirmative Memories, Alternative Futures: Remembering Otherwise in Sinophone Cultural Worlds

Published2026-10-08

Call for Papers: JEACS 8.2 (2027)

Special Issue: Affirmative Memories, Alternative Futures: Remembering Otherwise in Sinophone Cultural Worlds

We invite original research articles on Sinophone cultural worlds, memory, temporality and futurity.

Contributors are required to submit an abstract for discussion with the guest editors, Serena De Marchi, Simona Gallo and Irmy Schweiger.

  • Deadline for abstracts: February 28, 2027
  • Notification of abstract acceptance: March 31, 2027
  • Submission of full articles: July 15, 2027
  • Article length: max. 8,000 words
  • Language: English
